title: LabProvider capability report (v0.1)
description: Machine-verifiable capability report emitted by every LabProvider. Scenario meta.requires is validated against the same vocabulary; matching is done by lab/providers/scheduler.py. Reports must state substrate truth (e.g. the e2b TCG provider reports emulator_acceleration 'none' — never 'kvm').

verified_utc.description: when the capability claims were last empirically verified (acceptance gate); null = claimed, not yet verified

notes.description: per-capability provenance notes (e.g. how camera_fixture is realized)
